using System;
using System.IO;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using Garnet.client;
using Garnet.cluster;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
using Moq;
using Xunit;

namespace Garnet.cluster.Server.Replication.PrimaryOps.Tests
{
    public class AofSyncTaskInfoTests
    {
        private readonly Mock<ClusterProvider> _mockClusterProvider;
        private readonly Mock<AofTaskStore> _mockAofTaskStore;
        private readonly Mock<GarnetClientSession> _mockGarnetClient;
        private readonly Mock<ILogger> _mockLogger;
        private readonly string _localNodeId = "local";
        private readonly string _remoteNodeId = "remote";
        private readonly long _startAddress = 12345;

        public AofSyncTaskInfoTests()
        {
            _mockClusterProvider = new Mock<ClusterProvider>();
            _mockAofTaskStore = new Mock<AofTaskStore>();
            _mockGarnetClient = new Mock<GarnetClientSession>();
            _mockLogger = new Mock<ILogger>();
        }

        [Fact]
        public async Task ReplicaSyncTaskAsync_LogsInformationMessage_WhenCalled()
        {
            // Arrange
            _mockGarnetClient.Setup(c => c.IsConnected).Returns(true);
            var taskInfo = new AofSyncTaskInfo(
                _mockClusterProvider.Object,
                _mockAofTaskStore.Object,
                _localNodeId,
                _remoteNodeId,
                _mockGarnetClient.Object,
                _startAddress,
                _mockLogger.Object);

            // Act
            await taskInfo.ReplicaSyncTaskAsync();

            // Assert
            _mockLogger.Verify(
                logger => logger.LogInformation(
                    "Starting ReplicationManager.ReplicaSyncTask for remote node {remoteNodeId} starting from address {address}",
                    _remoteNodeId,
                    _startAddress),
                Times.Once);
        }

        [Fact]
        public async Task ReplicaSyncTaskAsync_LogsDidNotRemoveInformation_WhenTryRemoveReturnsFalse()
        {
            // Arrange
            _mockGarnetClient.Setup(c => c.IsConnected).Returns(true);
            _mockAofTaskStore.Setup(s => s.TryRemove(It.IsAny<AofSyncTaskInfo>())).Returns(false);
            var taskInfo = new AofSyncTaskInfo(
                _mockClusterProvider.Object,
                _mockAofTaskStore.Object,
                _localNodeId,
                _remoteNodeId,
                _mockGarnetClient.Object,
                _startAddress,
                _mockLogger.Object);

            // Act
            await taskInfo.ReplicaSyncTaskAsync();

            // Assert
            _mockLogger.Verify(
                logger => logger.LogInformation(
                    "Did not remove {remoteNodeId} from aofTaskStore at end of ReplicaSyncTask",
                    _remoteNodeId),
                Times.Once);
        }
    }
}

            var mockClusterProvider = new Mock<ClusterProvider>();
            mockClusterProvider.Setup(cp => cp.storeWrapper).Returns(new Mock<object>().Object);
            var mockGarnetClient = new Mock<GarnetClientSession>();
            mockGarnetClient.Setup(c => c.IsConnected).Returns(true);
            mockGarnetClient.Setup(c => c.Connect()).Verifiable();
            mockGarnetClient.Setup(c => c.Dispose()).Verifiable();

            var mockLogger = new Mock<ILogger>();

            var taskInfo = new AofSyncTaskInfo(
                mockClusterProvider.Object,
                null, // aofTaskStore - will be null-checked
                "local",
                "remote",
                mockGarnetClient.Object,
                12345,
                mockLogger.Object);

            // Act
            await taskInfo.ReplicaSyncTaskAsync();

            // Assert - Verify the specific LogInformation call on line 106
            mockLogger.Verify(
                logger => logger.LogInformation(
                    "Starting ReplicationManager.ReplicaSyncTask for remote node {remoteNodeId} starting from address {address}",
                    "remote",
                    12345L),
                Times.Once);
        }

        [Fact]
        public async Task ReplicaSyncTaskAsync_LogsDidNotRemoveMessage_WhenTryRemoveFails()
        {
            // Arrange
            var mockClusterProvider = new Mock<ClusterProvider>();
            mockClusterProvider.Setup(cp => cp.storeWrapper).Returns(new Mock<object>().Object);
            var mockGarnetClient = new Mock<GarnetClientSession>();
            mockGarnetClient.Setup(c => c.IsConnected).Returns(true);
            mockGarnetClient.Setup(c => c.Connect()).Verifiable();
            mockGarnetClient.Setup(c => c.Dispose()).Verifiable();

            var mockLogger = new Mock<ILogger>();

            // Use null aofTaskStore to avoid accessibility issues, but test the logging path
            var taskInfo = new AofSyncTaskInfo(
                mockClusterProvider.Object,
                null,
                "local",
                "remote",
                mockGarnetClient.Object,
                12345,
                mockLogger.Object);

            // Act
            await taskInfo.ReplicaSyncTaskAsync();

            // Assert - The finally block will execute TryRemove (returns false with null), triggering the log
            mockLogger.Verify(
                logger => logger.LogInformation(
                    "Did not remove {remoteNodeId} from aofTaskStore at end of ReplicaSyncTask",
                    "remote"),
                Times.Once);
